normalization_method: Parse committed UTF-8 JSON, remove normalized_evidence_sha256, serialize with sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false and allow_nan=false, then SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes.

corrections.root_cause: The original digest was calculated from the pre-serialization Python object. Integral-valued float fields were serialized into the committed JSON as integer tokens, so the stored digest did not match the committed representation.

The original digest was calculated from the pre-serialization Python object. Numeric fields were normalized by the committed JSON serialization, so the stored digest did not match the committed representation.
